PUC DOCKET NO. 59475

JOINT APPLICATION OF ONCOR ELECTRIC DELIVERY COMPANY LLC AND LCRA TRANSMISSION SERVICE CORPORATION TO AMEND THEIR CERTIFICATES OF CONVENIENCE AND NECESSITY FOR THE BELL COUNTY EAST SWITCH TO BIG HILL SUBSTATION 765-KV TRANSMISSION LINE PROJECT IN BELL, BURNET, CONCHO, CORYELL, LAMPASAS, LLANO, MASON, MCCULLOCH, MENARD, MILAM, MILLS, SAN SABA, SCHLEICHER, TOM GREEN, AND WILLIAMSON COUNTIES
Direct Testimony of Craig Peterson in Opposition to Segment F8


My name is Craig Peterson and I am the owner of Tract 5209 which is bisected by segment F8. The property is roughly 33 acres of hill country views which will be greatly devalued by the project. The high point at roughly 1063’ presents a 360-degree view of the surrounding area but the longest view of several miles is toward the river which is where the power line will be. 
The property is 100% leased for grazing and I have been notified that the line may affect that ability to lease in the future. Cattle may be affected but the abundant wildlife will definitely be hurt. Hunting is not allowed and deer and turkey populations are significant.
The easement will represent a significant percentage of the total property and degrade any opportunities to sell the property.

Exhibit A
Alternative Routing
It seems this route was not carefully considered as there is an existing powerline and easement as close as 5,000’ to F8 in more than one place. My property would be about 10,000’ from the existing line. It appears that the total length of either route would be about the same. 
There should be no structural difference since F8 does use the existing powerline easement when it approaches Texas 195. Further, 16 Texas Administrative Code § 25.101(b)(3)(B) requires that transmission facilities be routed, to the extent reasonable, to moderate impacts on affected landowners and communities including the use of existing compatible rights-of-way where appropriate.

Craig Peterson
2139 Tangley St
Houston, Texas 77005
